_doc: SkippyCore's model slots. Each slot has a small STAND-IN (the simulator and CI run it) and the FULL model the Bosgame runs. Same slot, same aliases, same API: switching is CORE_FULL=<slots> in /etc/skippy-core/core.env, never a code change. Paths are relative to MODELS_ROOT and follow tools/models_archive.py's layout (huggingface/<Org>__<Repo>/<file>), so the D:\models archive copies over as-is. sha256 null = not pinned yet: core/llm/models.py fetch prints the hash to pin. Sizes are bytes as Hugging Face lists them (2026-10-16). The coder's full GGUF is Unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL, re-uploaded after llama.cpp's looping fix (the Strix Halo community's pick). parallel (per variant, default 4) is llama-server's --parallel; max_parallel caps it: stock Vulkan loses about a third of its throughput past 8. The chat stand-in runs with --reasoning-budget 0: Qwen3-0.6B would otherwise spend its answer thinking and reply with empty content. core/README.md.

chat.role: Skippy's default tier, summaries, Mentat's phrasings: always loaded

general.role: the big general tier: tools, long answers. Loaded on demand; swaps with coder

coder.role: the coding fallback (Claude Code via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL). Loaded on demand; swaps with general
